There are now more than a dozen data centers in Galvan’s roughly 55-square-mile district, and he expects that number to grow to around 20 over the next few years if proposed projects are completed. During the pandemic, Thomas thought he would give DraftKings and FanDuel a try. Before long, he formed a habit. "I could have ten drinks one night and then be fine with not drinking again for a year," said Thomas, 35, who asked to be identified by his middle name fearing his problem gambling history could affect his career. "But sports gambling was different. It really got me." He never cared much for sports. Yet betting on games seemed like an easy way to make a buck. He started placing wagers on football and tennis mostly using parlays, which are difficult-to-win bets that require multiple things happening in one game in order to land an enticing payout. Working from his home in Pennsylvania in the financial services industry, Thomas says there were few moments when he didn't have one eye on placing a bet as he juggled work emails and meetings. When his paycheck arrived, he'd quickly squander it all trying to dig himself out of a gambling hole, only to find himself even deeper in. items.article: Gary Sutton's scheduled execution has been paused after Tennessee Governor Bill Lee halted remaining 2026 executions following Christa Pike's failed lethal injection. Gary Wayne Sutton, a Tennessee death row inmate, has had his execution paused after Governor Bill Lee suspended all remaining executions in the state for 2026 following the failed execution of Christa Pike . Sutton was convicted of the 1992 killings of siblings Tommy Griffin and Connie Branam and has spent three decades on death row. Sutton was scheduled to receive a lethal injection on December 3, but Lee’s order to suspend executions for the rest of the year means the sentence will not be carried out as planned. Sutton, 61, was convicted in 1992 alongside his uncle, James Dellinger, for the murders of Tommy Griffin and Griffin’s sister, Connie Branam. The pair were sentenced to life in prison, and later received death sentences for Griffin’s murder. Dellinger died in prison in 2023 aged 71. Griffin, 24, was found shot in the back of the head near the Little River on February 24, 1992. Branam, 34, was discovered five days later inside her burned vehicle. At the time, Griffin’s family reported an ongoing feud between their family and Sutton’s before the killings.

Pike and Shipp spent the following 30 minutes brutally attacking the 19-year-old with various weapons while Peterson stood guard.
